body:
**# Create Compat Recipes**

Adds a collection of Create mod recipes for items that vanilla Minecraft lacks 
automation-friendly crafting paths for.

![Red Mushroom + Dirt → Mycelium](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a88ed2bbc5708c508535bc0dab9b846355e9c84.png)

**## Recipes Added**

**Mixer**
- Brown or Red Mushroom + Dirt → Mycelium
- Cinder Flour + Sugar + 100mb Milk → Blaze Cake Base
- Netherrack + Nether Sprouts → Warped Nylium
- Netherrack + Nether Wart → Crimson Nylium
- Dirt + Gravel → Coarse Dirt
- Netherrack + 1000mb Lava → Magma Block *(Heated)*
- Soul Sand + 1000mb Lava → Magma Block *(Heated)*
- Soul Sand + 250mb Lava → Soul Soil *(Heated)*
- Netherrack → Nether Brick *(Superheated)*

**Millstone & Crushing Wheel**
- Diorite → Calcite

**Spout**
- 4x String + 100mb Water → Cobweb
- Cobblestone/Brick variants + 100mb Water → Mossy variants (8 block types)

**Press**
- Mud → Packed Mud
- Stone → Deepslate *(Superheated)*
- Cobblestone → Cobbled Deepslate *(Superheated)*
- Clay → Terracotta *(Superheated)*

**Deployer**
- Coarse Dirt + any Leaves (non-cherry) → Podzol
- Sand Paper + Sand → Sand Paper (repaired)
- Red Sand Paper + Red Sand → Red Sand Paper (repaired)
